newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine March car output up 26.4 pct vs March 96.
newsitem.headline: Argentine March car output up 26.4 pct vs March 96.

text.p: Argentine car production in March was 30,882 vehicles, up 26.4 percent from March 1996 and 10.7 percent from February, the Association of Automobile Manufacturers (ADEFA) said Friday.
Output in the first three months was 47.9 percent higher than the level produced in the first quarter of 1996, ADEFA said in a statement.
Sales in the domestic market totaled 31,474 vehicles, up 5.9 percent from March 1996 and 7.4 percent from February 1997.
Exports, at 13,115, were 87.6 percent higher than March 1996 and 47.2 percent up from February 1997.
